semiconductor_relevance: High — Adirtek specializes in SECS/GEM solutions which are critical for communication and control in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Adirtek Co., Ltd. is a technology company focused on providing SECS/GEM solutions for the semiconductor industry, enabling efficient communication between non-SECS devices and equipment in fabrication plants. Their flagship products, the SECI Box and AnyGate, facilitate quick and easy connectivity for various devices without extensive coding requirements.
capabilities: SECI Box for plug-and-play device integration
AnyGate for SECS/GEM functionality on PCs
SECS/GEM driver for custom software development
